grammar.title: 一般将来时态
lines: 一般将来时态 § 注意：大多数情况下will 与 be going to 是可以互相替换的。只是在语气有点一些细微的差异，Will 强调意愿、临时性，而be going to 强调预兆性、计划性。 结构差异 B 与 C 对话中的be going to与will在上述对话中不能互换，尝试想一下为什么？
主 语 + is\am\are going to + v. (原形) 主语 + will + v. (原形)
He will come on time. 他会准时来的。 The woman will talk for hours about nothing. 那个女人将会哇啦哇啦一连胡说上几个小时。 He will show his true colors someday. 他总有一天会现出原形的。
主语 + will + be + 非动词
The speaker will be our old friend, John. 演讲者将是我们的老朋友约翰。 Her sublimate future husband will be tall, dark, and handsome. 她理想化的未来丈夫将是身材高大，皮肤浅黑，相貌英俊。
您的浏览器不支持媒体播放
疑问句（will 提前） 否定句（will + not）

He will come on time. → Will he come on time? The woman will talk for hours about nothing. → Will the woman talk for….? He will show his true colors someday. → Will he show …? The speaker will be our old friend, John. → The speaker will not be our old friend, John. Her sublimate future husband will not be tall, dark, and handsome.
两种结构在口语上无太多的区别，但是书面上有不同的强调点。
主语 + is\am\are going to + v. (原形) 主语 + will + v. (原形)
主语 + is\am\are going to + 非动词 主语 + will + be + 非动词
强调客观、马上、预先计划。 主观意愿(非客观)、非马上(更长远)、临时性发生的(非计划)。
A: Mary is in hospital!
B: Yes,I know,I am going to see her tomorrow. 因为A早知道了，所以有计划的去看她。 C: Really! I will see her tomorrow. 因为B 不知道，所以临时决定去看她。
Look at the black clouds! It’s going to rain . 强调客观
Look! Jim is going to fall into the river! 马上
They are going to get married next month. 预先计划

expand.title: 表将来的其他结构
lines: be about to + v. 即将(马上、正要) be + to do 指按计划或安排将要发生某事（必须做）
We are about to leave. 我们要走了。
He is about to finish his study. 他即将完成学业。
We are to meet at the zoo. 我们约定在动物园见面。
The football match is to play at 8:00 today.今天足球比赛将在 8 点举行。

Be on the verge of 新闻、重大转折（极度紧迫/剧变） The two countries are on the verge of signing a peace treaty. (两国即将签署和平协议。) The company is on the brink of bankruptcy. (公司正处于破产边缘。) I was on the point of leaving when the phone rang. (我正要出门，电话响了。)

Be due to 交通、会议、预产期（按照时刻表） The plane is due to take off in 10 minutes. (飞机预定在10分钟后起飞。) Interest rates are set to rise next month. (利率预计将在下个月上调。) I have every intention of finishing this project tonight. (我今晚绝对打算把这个项目做完。)

Be slated to 电影档期、产品发布（被安排好的） The new movie is slated to be released this summer. (新片定于今年夏天上映。) I am inclined to believe his story. (我倾向于相信他的故事。) She is contemplating changing her career. (她正在考虑换个职业。)
Be destined to 文学、励志演讲（上天注定的） He was destined to lead the country. (他命中注定要领导这个国家。) The project was doomed to fail from the start. (这个项目从一开始就注定要失败。)
